name: War Mode
description: Bends the whole session toward one free-form goal: TPM becomes the autonomous god of that goal, decomposing it into sub-purposes and growing a persistent roster of dedicated gholas via the ghola ledger.

autoOpenWarRoom.label: Auto-Open War Room
autoOpenWarRoom.description: When on (default), starting or resuming War Mode auto-reveals the War Room tab so roster and activity are visible without a manual click. When off, the tab stays wherever the user left it.

tournament.label: Tournament Mode
tournament.description: When on, TPM may run rival gholas on a hard sub-purpose and keep the best result, retiring the rest. When off (default), exactly one ghola runs per sub-purpose. On multiplies token and time cost.

maxConcurrentGholas.label: Max Concurrent Gholas
maxConcurrentGholas.description: Ceiling on gholas active at once for this mission. 0 (default) means unbounded. A positive number queues additional sub-purposes until a slot frees; the file-ownership rule still applies regardless.

dryRun.label: Dry Run
dryRun.description: When on, TPM plans the mission (decomposition, roster, initial briefs) and reports it for review, without spawning gholas or editing files. Off (default) runs straight into an autonomous run.

autoVerify.label: Auto-run QA Verification
autoVerify.description: Controls WHEN QA verification is dispatched, not whether it's required. Off (default): TPM proposes the verification pass and waits for the operator's go-ahead. On: TPM auto-dispatches QA as soon as the crew returns. Either way, a sub-purpose is never done until verification passes.
